comment: Base settings for every mapped field. These are layered, later layers overriding earlier ones: 'defaults' (all fields), then the section's '*' entry, then the entry for the specific Zotero field / creator type / normalized Extra key, then the item type mapping file's own entry. 'type' is an Omeka data type (literal, uri, resource:item, resource:itemset, resource:media, or one added by another module; aliases: text, resource, item, itemset, media). 'language' sets @language. 'pipeline' lists processors (files in processors/) run in order; a stage is a name or an object {"name": ..., <options>}. A pipeline replaces the inherited one, except that the stage "@default" is replaced by the inherited stages. Terms are not set here; they come from the item type files.
